description: This file defines utility functions for resolving extension directories, counting test files, generating test plans, creating test shards, and related logic for managing extension test configurations in a JavaScript project. It imports several external modules and internal functions related to extension paths and configurations.

methods.name: normalizeRelative
methods.description: Converts a filesystem path to a normalized relative path with forward slashes.

methods.name: countTestFiles
methods.description: Recursively counts the number of test files (.test.ts, .test.tsx) in a given directory.

methods.name: resolveExtensionDirectory
methods.description: Resolves and returns the path to an extension directory based on a target argument, either by name or path within the project structure.

methods.name: resolveExtensionTestPlan
methods.description: Generates a test plan object for a specific extension, including tests presence, configuration file, roots, and test file count.

methods.name: mergeTestPlans
methods.description: Merges multiple test plan objects into a consolidated plan grouped by configuration.

methods.name: resolveExtensionBatchPlan
methods.description: Creates a consolidated plan for multiple extensions, optionally specified by IDs.

methods.name: pickLeastLoadedShard
methods.description: Selects the shard with the least total test files and plans to balance workload.

methods.name: createExtensionTestShards
methods.description: Divides extension tests into shards for parallel execution, balancing based on test counts.
